title: Score a point
subtitle: Chapter 4 of 9
instructions: Warm and plain spoken, like a friend showing you their app. Brisk and light on its feet, keeping things moving, but never rushed or clipped. No salesy lift at the end of sentences.

lines.text: Open any point and you get that rally on its own.
You can say who won it.
You can also add how the point ended, and what went wrong.
Every point also maps where the ball landed, and traces the line the rally took.
And your notes sit on the point itself, right beside the rally they are about.
Those answers are what fill in the match analysis and your stats.
